about.title: About LifeLog
about.p1: LifeLog is my technical logbook. A living record of my journey as a developer — projects, discoveries, epic bugs, and everything I learn along the way.
about.p2: Each post has a unique visual theme depending on the project. If I'm talking about Arachne, you see the purple web. If it's about Dogwalk, the palette shifts to orange. The project defines the post's look.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How LifeLog handles your personal data under LGPD.
privacy.intro: This policy explains which data LifeLog collects, why, where it is stored and how you can exercise your rights under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018).

section1.title: 1. What data is collected
section1.text: LifeLog collects only two kinds of data: (a) anonymous browsing data — page visited, referrer and device type — and only after you click "Accept" on the cookie banner; (b) the email you voluntarily type into the subscribe form shown at the end of posts.

section2.title: 2. How the data is used
section2.text: Browsing data tells me which posts get read so I can improve the content. The email is used only to send new posts and LifeLog updates. There is no advertising use, commercial profiling or automated decision-making.

section3.title: 3. Legal basis
section3.text: Analytics: consent (art. 7, I of LGPD), revocable at any time via the "Review preferences" link in the footer. Subscription email: consent given when submitting the form (art. 7, I), with one-click unsubscribe in every message.

section4.title: 4. Where the data is stored
section4.text: Browsing data lives in OpenPanel, a self-hosted instance under my control, cookieless and without individual identification. Subscription email lives in the LifeLog mailing platform. Neither is sold, rented or handed to third parties for commercial purposes.

section5.title: 5. Cookies and local storage
section5.text: LifeLog uses no tracking cookies. Your browser's local storage keeps only preferences: theme, color palette, language, whether you dismissed the RSS notice and your consent choice. None of it is sent to a server.

section6.title: 6. Your rights (LGPD)
section6.text: Under Law 13.709/2018 you have the right to:

rights.correction: Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data
rights.deletion: Delete personal data processed with consent
rights.portability: Port your data to another service provider

section7.title: 7. Controller contact
section7.text: Controller: Samuel Medeiros. To exercise any right or clarify privacy questions, write to

section4.title: 4. Limitation of Liability

section5.title: 5. External Links
